purpose: NIKKE-inspired painted materials/art for a Heroes of the Storm-style HUD

assets.name: panel
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready square 2D game HUD panel texture for nine-slice scaling. Create ONE square sci-fi HUD plate inspired by Goddess of Victory NIKKE's refined anime military UI and Heroes of the Storm's substantial game UI materials. Orthographic perfectly front-facing, full bleed exactly square. A narrow, uninterrupted, fully CLOSED satin silver/ivory steel frame runs around all four sides, with square outer corners and tiny mitered bevel joints; NO gaps anywhere. Frame occupies outer 8 percent of each edge. Fine hand-painted edge highlights, blue-gray reflected shadows, minimal subtle brushed metal grain, clean durable painted alloy, not grunge. Inner 84 percent is very dark desaturated navy graphite with extremely subtle painted material grain, empty and calm so controls can be layered over it. No central motif, no buttons, no symbols, no labels, no screws, no rivets, no lights, no text, no logo, no perspective, no background beyond the square plate. The image must reach all four canvas edges with no margin. High-quality anime game interface material painting, legible when scaled down. 1024x1024.

assets.name: skill-socket
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production-ready 2D game UI button socket texture. NIKKE-inspired clean satin ivory/silver military metal and Heroes of the Storm's thick complete beveled ability frames. Orthographic front view, square 1024x1024 canvas. Single point-up hexagon fills the whole canvas, exact vertices at (50%,0%),(100%,25%),(100%,75%),(50%,100%),(0%,75%),(0%,25%). The outer 8% forms a substantial CONTINUOUS CLOSED silver steel ring with layered broad beveled facets, very subtle hand-painted brushed alloy grain, bright top-left edges and dark blue-gray lower-right edges, clean polished anime game UI shading. No breaks or gaps anywhere on all six sides. Inside the ring is a plain flat deep navy recessed well. Outside the hexagon corners is actual transparent alpha. No padding at top/bottom/left/right vertices. No icon, text, symbols, lights, screws or rivets, no busy ornament, no perspective. Designed to have ability artwork layered over the center.

assets.name: hoverboard
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one square full-bleed game ability illustration for a MOBA hoverboard/mount button, 1024 by 1024 composition, designed to stay readable when cropped into a hexagon and displayed at 48 to 112 pixels. Primary request: a single futuristic white-and-gray antigravity hoverboard angled from lower left toward upper right, with bright cyan engine jets and a few broad soft-blue speed streaks. NIKKE-inspired anime military science-fiction equipment painting, hand-painted cel shading, crisp dark contours, deliberate broad highlights, rich but controlled colors. The board is the one central subject, fills about 75 percent of the square, and has a bold simple recognizable silhouette. Deep navy background extends to every edge, with darker uncluttered corners. Materials: white painted armor plates, dark graphite underside, restrained steel edging, luminous cyan thrusters. Camera is a dramatic three-quarter view, not a diagram. No rider, no humans or faces, no additional objects. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, UI frame, button rim, border, or checkerboard. Opaque image, not transparent. Avoid fine decorative clutter, photorealistic rendering, and miniature components that disappear at icon size.

assets.name: recall

NIKKE-inspired anime military science-fiction equipment painting, hand-painted cel shading, crisp dark contours, deliberate broad highlights, rich but controlled colors. The ring and its central beacon form one strong, simple recognizable silhouette, fill about 75 percent of the square, and remain fully visible in a central hexagonal crop. Show a small sturdy angular tower emerging from the platform inside the glowing portal ring, conveying a home-base return destination without any text. Deep navy background extends to every edge, with darker uncluttered corners. Materials: white painted armor plates, graphite base, restrained steel edging, cyan energy light. Three-quarter view with readable depth, not photorealistic. No people, faces, vehicles, surrounding buildings, or additional decorative objects.
